records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:124 — The CalendarEvent passed to sendAddGuestsEmails never sets the team field, so team members are silently never notified of the added guest.
records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the CalendarEvent `evt` passed to `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is constructed without a `team` property (it sets organizer/attendees/etc., but no `team`). In email-manager.ts, `sendAddGuestsEmails` only notifies team members inside `if (calendarEvent.team?.members) { ... }`, so with `team` unset that branch will never run and team members won’t be emailed.

records.issue_text: packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.handler.ts:169 — The catch block around sendAddGuestsEmails discards the actual error object and only logs a static string via console.log.
records.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts the new try/catch wraps `await sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests);` and the `catch (err)` only does `console.log("Error sending AddGuestsEmails")` without logging/handling `err`. This is verifiable in the diff and is a substantive observability/diagnostics concern (error context is discarded), though it doesn’t directly break functionality since the handler continues.

records.issue_text: packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx:46 — The "Remove email" tooltip text is hardcoded in English instead of using the component's useLocale/t() translation function.
records.rationale: In packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx, the Tooltip is rendered with a hardcoded English string: `<Tooltip content="Remove email">` instead of using `t(...)` from `useLocale()`, so non-English locales will still see English text (broken localization behavior).
